description: PM-posture skill that splits the picked 根回し Nemawashi seed into the 1 to N 宿場 Shukuba stations that will actually be walked, rewriting that seed's own station checklist in place. The checklist a seed arrives with is the cutter's proposal, written by a seat that never walked the product; this is where it becomes the route. Requires PM posture and halts outside a pm session or the pm subagent. It writes only the checklist section and the divergence lines that go with it — no station file, no change_request.md — so the next moves stay the PM's own. Use when a seed has just been picked and its route has to be settled, or when a seed reached the root with no checklist at all. After a change unit lands, re-cutting the route against what the unit found is shukuba-refine's, not this skill's.
